name: DaVinci Resolve
description: Video editing in DaVinci Resolve: importing, cutting and trimming, titles and transitions, basic color correction and exporting.
appVersionTested: DaVinci Resolve 20.x and 21.x (free and Studio), checked against the official manual and shortcut lists
notes: The free edition has no external scripting, so lessons are verified with vision, window title and key presses only. The resolve-studio bridge (Studio 21.1 or later) is listed as an optional alternate check. UIA quality is an estimate: menus and some dialogs are exposed, panels, timeline and color wheels are custom drawn. Region fractions assume the default layout of each page at 1920 by 1080.
